description: Manage, inspect, update, and build Packwiz modpacks.

global-items.label: -V, --version
global-items.description: Print the loaded local version without network access.

global-items.label: -p, --project <id>
global-items.description: Use this project instead of the active project; accepted in any position.

global-items.label: --color auto|always|never
global-items.description: Control color; auto follows terminal detection and NO_COLOR.

global-items.label: --json
global-items.description: Emit a schema-versioned JSON envelope on stdout in addition to human presentation.

global-items.label: --no-human
global-items.description: Suppress human presentation when --json is enabled. Requires --json.

notes: Run modpack <command> --help for operations and examples.
Options use exact names; command prefixes are not accepted.
The Nushell adapter enables --json automatically and returns parsed structured values.

commands.name: content

items.description: Enable an added resource-pack batch at priority position n.

items.label: --strict
items.description: Require complete verification and a clean resulting graph.

items.label: --allow-downgrade
items.description: Allow dependency resolution to select an older installed version.

items.label: -n, --dry-run
items.description: Prepare and validate without applying project changes.

items.label: -y, --yes
items.description: Apply a displayed removal plan without confirmation.

items.label: -h, --help
items.description: Show help for this command.

items.label: -p, --project <id>
items.description: Use this project for project-bound operations.

items.label: --color auto|always|never
items.description: Control color; auto follows terminal detection and NO_COLOR.

items.label: --ascii
items.description: Use ASCII symbols for presentation.

items.label: --json
items.description: Also emit a schema-versioned JSON envelope on stdout.

items.label: --no-human
items.description: Suppress human presentation. Requires --json.

notes: Search can run globally. Project-filtered search, inventory, version, and category numbers have separate project-bound contexts.
Global search numbers may be used after selecting a project; compatibility is still checked when adding.
Local files cannot be updated or pinned. Pins block explicit changes.
Multiple selectors are resolved and committed as one transaction.
